text: Art plays an important role in human life because it allows people to share their imagination and creativity with others. Some people believe that anyone can be artistic if they practise regularly, while others think that talent is something you are born with. Although both opinions have some truth, most experts agree that developing a good technique takes years of practice, no matter how talented someone is. In cities around the world, galleries hold exhibitions where visitors can appreciate paintings, sculptures, and other works of art. A single masterpiece, whether it is an abstract painting on canvas or a bronze sculpture, can inspire thousands of people. Artists often use vivid colours and expressive shapes to portray emotions that words cannot easily describe. In fact, for many artists, creating art is simply a form of self-expression. Today, technology has produced innovative new tools, such as digital painting programs, that let artists craft their work in exciting new ways. As a result, art has become more accessible than ever, and more people than before are able to exhibit their creativity publicly.
